notes.title: Release Note - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where football players may move while joystick is untouched.
Enabled players to control movement speed more precisely.

notes.title: Release Note – Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
Thanks so much for your support through Playtest. Today Funny Football is officially released along with a demo version. You can try the demo version first with the default game mode (controlling two football players by your two hands at the same time to against easy AI), then unlock other game modes including the local PVP mode by purchasing the full version after you make sure you really enjoy this game.

The following is change logs:
Adjusted UI layout to fit screens with resolution other than 1920x1080 better.
Replaced BGM with more inspirational ones.

	Main Menu BGM:
        Action Rock by MaxKoMusic | https://maxkomusic.com/
        Music promoted by https://www.chosic.com/free-music/all/
        Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)
        https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

	In-game BGM:
        Hard As Steel by Alex-Productions | https://onsound.eu/
        Music promoted by https://www.chosic.com/free-music/all/
        Creative Commons CC BY 3.0
        https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

notes.title: Release Notes - Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
Most texts in this game can be translated into the following languages by changing your preferred language on the right top corner of the main menu:
Arabic
French
English
German
Japanese
Korean
Portuguese
Russian
Simplified Chinese
Spanish

The remaining few will be completed soon.

notes.title: Release Notes - Update 0.4.5
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where AI football players may stuck with their gatepost when football is near the gatepost.
Fixed an issue where the right joystick of the controller may sometimes not be able to control the movements of the football player #2 as expected.

notes.title: Release Notes - Update 0.4.4
notes.content:
Remade instruction panel which explains how to move players, switch players, kick, heavy kick and surpass with animation.
